content.value: Steam is flowing through a horizontal nozzle. At the inlet to the nozzle, the enthalpy of the fluid passing is 3500 kJ/kg and the velocity is 50 m/sec. At exit, the enthalpy is 2775 kJ/kg. If the loss from the nozzle is 4.5 kJ/kg, then find the velocity of the fluid at exit from the nozzle. If the inlet area is 0.15 m<sup>2</sup> and the specific volume of steam at inlet is 0.18 m<sup>3</sup>/kg, find the mass flow rate.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
